findings.observation: The entire sword is visible, but the pommel begins around 4% below the top edge and the blade point ends around 5% above the bottom edge, violating the required 8% safe margin.
Exactly one complete sword is shown, with blade, guard, grip, and pommel and no second object or prop.
The long straight double-edged blade, crossguard, extended two-hand-capable grip, and pommel read immediately as a practical hand-and-a-half sword.
Blade shoulders seat cleanly at the guard, the leather-wrapped grip has plausible hand scale, and the substantial pommel and straight fuller support credible balance and construction.
Steel dominates the blade, guard, and pommel; the brown leather grip remains neutral and subordinate without asserting a second visible rank.
A forged central fuller, distinct sharpened edges, narrow cool reflections, and fine honest scuffs establish worked steel beyond palette alone.
No supernatural emission or full-object glow is present; visible brightness is confined to controlled reflected highlights along the steel.
The realistic painterly dark-fantasy finish, restrained wear, cold key and warm rim, midnight-charcoal background, and subtle floor plane follow the accepted profile.

Inspection found no transferred subject or hammer, published-character resemblance, rarity rainbow, gold inflation, full-object glow, oversized silhouette, ornamental material substitute, extra gear, text, labels, UI, border, frame, logo, or watermark.
